reviews.author: Michael S.
reviews.text: This has been a great lawn service. They have been cutting my lawn for over a year now and it always looks great. Specifically I have asked small details such as for them to cut my grass a little higher to match my neighbor and they did it. I get texts asking for feedback (very professional).

summary: Lawn care, landscape design and grounds maintenance for homes, HOAs, apartment communities and commercial properties in Pasadena, The Woodlands, Houston and the surrounding areas.

groups.title: Residential
groups.summary: Landscape design, lawn care, tree and shrub care, lighting and seasonal cleanup for your home.
groups.intro: Our professional landscaping services are designed to transform your outdoor spaces into beautiful, functional and sustainable environments. Whether you want to enhance the curb appeal of your home, create a serene garden retreat or maintain a vibrant landscape, our team is here to help.
groups.imageAlt: Square stepping stones through gray gravel beside a newly planted flower bed with stone edging

groups.title: Commercial
groups.summary: Landscaping and grounds maintenance for offices, retail centers, industrial complexes and other commercial properties.
groups.intro: Our commercial landscaping services are tailored to the needs of businesses, offices, retail centers, industrial complexes and other commercial properties. Whether you want to enhance the exterior of your building, maintain large green spaces or make your outdoor areas more sustainable, we offer a full range of services.
groups.imageAlt: A row of CA Company Services pickup trucks parked in a lot

groups.title: Healthcare
groups.summary: Landscaping and lawn care for hospitals, clinics, medical centers and nursing homes.
groups.intro: The grounds of hospitals, clinics and medical centers play a part in patient recovery, staff well-being and how the facility is seen. We provide tailored landscaping and lawn care for healthcare settings, creating and maintaining outdoor spaces that support healing, promote wellness and feel calm for patients, visitors and staff.

groups.title: Parks
groups.summary: Design, installation and maintenance for parks, from large urban parks to small neighborhood green spaces.
groups.intro: We provide landscaping for parks of all sizes, from large urban parks to small neighborhood green spaces. Our work supports both the natural ecosystem and the needs of park visitors, so every park is a safe, accessible and beautiful place for everyone to enjoy. From initial design and installation to ongoing maintenance, we offer a full range of landscaping services to keep your park looking its best year-round.

services.title: Park Master Plans
services.text: Our landscapers work with park authorities, municipalities and community organizations on park master plans that balance function with looks.

groups.title: Retail
groups.summary: Landscaping that gives retail stores and shopping centers curb appeal and a welcoming first impression.
groups.intro: For retail stores, first impressions matter. Whether you run a small boutique or a large shopping center, our landscaping is tailored to your business, improving curb appeal and keeping your property clean, safe and inviting year-round.

groups.title: Industrial
groups.summary: Durable, low-maintenance landscaping and lawn care for manufacturing plants, distribution centers and industrial complexes.
groups.intro: Industrial properties need landscapes that balance function, safety and looks. Whether it is a manufacturing facility, a distribution center or an industrial complex, we provide landscaping and lawn care that improve the appearance, function and sustainability of your outdoor spaces.

about.title: A partner you can count on
text: CA Company Services is committed to helping properties across the Greater Houston area look their best year-round. We take pride in building long-term partnerships through quality workmanship, dependable service and clear communication.

We are dedicated to top-notch lawn care for both residential and commercial clients. Our landscaping package delivers curb appeal with lush greenery all year round, and we take pride in understanding what our clients need and exploring every possible solution when a challenge comes up.

Working with nature to showcase its beauty is why CA Company Services has built a reputation as a top lawn care service in Pasadena. Every lawn is unique, so our team works closely with you on a customized lawn care plan.
about.imageAlt: A CA Company Services pickup truck and trailer parked by a lake and a mowed lawn
